title: Existing coherent integer tensor-power construction
statement: In a monoidal category C, let L be an object with a chosen tensor inverse e: an object M and isomorphisms L tensor M to the unit and M tensor L to the unit. The integer tensor powers e.zpow admit a coherent family: their zero term is isomorphic to the unit, their a-th term tensored with their b-th term is isomorphic to the (a+b)-th term, and these comparison maps satisfy the left unit, right unit and associativity laws. The construction is the existing TensorInverse.intTensorFamily of the source library.

source.place: Existing proved TensorInverse.intTensorFamily, lines 56-73; coherent product laws proved in TensorInverse.lean. This node attaches an existing construction, rather than introducing a new Lean statement.

proof.text: Use the existing source-library construction verbatim. Its object family is e.zpow, zero comparison is the identity, product comparison is e.addIso. The named source-library addIso_zero_left, addIso_zero_right and addIso_assoc theorems prove the three coherent-family laws. No new Lean declaration is required.
